# Swahili-English Terms

:::cdi-message
- **ID:** JIO-R01
- **Type:** Reference
- **Audience:** Learners
- **Theme:** Language Support
:::

| Swahili | English |
|----------|----------|
| Kompyuta | Computer |
| Faili | File |
| Folda | Folder |
| Bonyeza | Click |
| Hifadhi | Save |
| Fungua | Open |
| Chapisha | Print |
| Mtandao | Internet |
| Kibodi | Keyboard |
| Kipanya | Mouse |

## Notes

Do not worry if you do not know all terms immediately.

You will become familiar with them as you continue learning and practicing.
